meta.title: ZRAM & swap
meta.description: Inspect compressed memory and configure existing ZRAM swap devices.

overviewHelp: Swap counters cover all devices since boot, in native kernel pages.
unsupported: Changes require Android ARM64 root. Browsing remains available.
planHelp: Applying resets this device. Its current memory limit is retained. Restore recovers the basic parameters captured before the first change in this boot; it does not restore swapped data or vendor policies.
inputHelp: Whole MiB: 16–{max}, or 0 to disable. Priority: 0–32767, or -1 for automatic.
bootHelp: Takes effect after saving. Runs once after boot completion; system services may override it.
applyConfirm: Stop swap and reset this device? Moving pages back to RAM can stall the device or fail. A later failure may leave swap inactive. Restore does not change the saved boot plan.
saveConfirm: Save this configuration? The running device is unchanged. Boot application, when enabled below, may stop swap and reset this device on future boots.
partialFailure: Some steps may already have completed. Refresh the state before another operation; automatic rollback is not guaranteed.
comparisonHelp: Immediate readings from the last operation. Reset clears statistics; these values do not measure performance improvement.
swapsHelp: Other swap devices and files are shown for reference.
protected: This device cannot be changed safely with the available information.

blocked.device_node: A matching block device node is unavailable.
blocked.swap_identity: An active swap device could not be identified.
blocked.mmd: Android mmd manages ZRAM. Changes are blocked.
blocked.manager_unknown: Android memory-manager state could not be read.
blocked.non_swap: Initialized outside active swap; it may contain a filesystem.
blocked.writeback: Writeback is configured. Resetting would discard its configuration.
blocked.recompression: Secondary compression is configured and cannot be restored here.
blocked.holders: Another block device holds this device.
blocked.mounted: This device is mounted as a filesystem.

errors.state_changed: Device state changed. Refresh before proceeding.
errors.device_protected: This device is protected from reset.
errors.insufficient_memory: Available memory is insufficient for swapoff.
errors.original_unavailable: No original configuration was captured in this boot.
errors.kernel_rejected: The kernel rejected the swap operation.
errors.format_failed: Formatting failed; swap may remain inactive.
errors.operation_timeout: Timed out; outcome unknown. Refresh before proceeding.

sizeError: Enter whole MiB from 16 to {max}, or 0 to disable.
algorithmError: Choose an algorithm available in this kernel.
planFailure: The saved plan state could not be confirmed. Refresh before trying again.
